================================================================================

SECURITY RECOMMENDATIONS:
================================================================================
1. Input Validation:
   - Implement strict input validation on all user inputs
   - Use whitelist-based validation where possible
   - Validate input length, format, and content

2. Output Encoding:
   - Always encode output based on context (HTML, JavaScript, CSS, URL)
   - Use proper encoding functions provided by your framework
   - Never trust user input, even if validated

3. Content Security Policy (CSP):
   - Implement a strict CSP header
   - Use 'unsafe-inline' and 'unsafe-eval' sparingly
   - Regularly review and update CSP policies

4. Security Headers:
   - Implement X-XSS-Protection header
   - Use X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
   - Set X-Frame-Options to prevent clickjacking

5. Framework Security Features:
   - Use your framework's built-in XSS protection
   - Enable auto-escaping in template engines
   - Keep frameworks and libraries updated
